blocks.text: Applied skilling courses for B.Tech students are specialized programs designed to provide practical, hands-on training and skill development in various engineering disciplines. These Programs bridge the gap between academic learning and industry demands by emphasizing the real-world application of theoretical concepts. By focusing on industry-relevant skills,they prepare students with the expertise and experience needed to excel in their professional careers upon graduation.

items.text: Practical Proficiency: Mastery of hands-on skills directly applicable to industry/community needs.
Problem-Solving Ability: Enhanced capability to solve real-world engineering challenges.
Industry Readiness: Preparation for immediate contribution to professional roles.
Technological Adaptability: Ability to adapt to and leverage new technologies effectively.
Career Advancement: Improved employability and potential for career growth.
